entries.name: Model Card Requirement
entries.body: Every AI model participating in routing must have a published model card.

entries.name: Bias Monitoring
entries.body: Continuous bias monitoring across demographic dimensions. Detected bias triggers routing adjustment.

entries.name: Cross-Dialect Mediation
entries.body: When a query spans multiple dialect zones, mediation follows sovereignty gradient resolution.

entries.name: Simulation Mode Governance
entries.body: Simulation outputs are clearly labeled and isolated from production. No simulation-to-production leakage.

entries.name: Annual Constitutional Review
entries.body: Full constitutional review annually. Findings presented to Council with amendment recommendations.

entries.name: Predictive Monoculture Detection
entries.body: Proactive detection of emerging concentration patterns before they reach critical severity.
